title: Supplemental jurisdiction
question: When can a federal court hear related claims that lack their own basis?

steps.note: Pendent claims from a common nucleus of operative fact; discretion to decline.
Pendent parties need a statutory hook; none for a county under § 1983 then.
A plaintiff cannot add a non-diverse defendant through the back door of ancillary jurisdiction.
No pendent-party jurisdiction without express statutory authority, which prompted § 1367.
Under § 1367 one plaintiff’s qualifying claim carries others who fall short on amount, not on diversity.
